seo.title: Caffeine Easy — Know When Caffeine Clears
seo.description: See when you'll be under your sleep threshold. Log a drink in a sentence, follow the day's caffeine on a timeline, save drinks to Apple Health, and check the widget. No accounts, no tracking.

hero.label: CAFFEINE TRACKER
hero.title: Know when your caffeine clears.
text: Log a drink in a sentence and Caffeine Easy tells you, in plain words, when you'll be under your sleep threshold. Ink on paper, with one color for the signal. No sign-up, no tracking.

items.title: Clear by a time you can read
items.text: Today says it the way you'd ask it: “Clear by 10:40 PM” and “84 mg in your system”, with what's left at your bedtime.

items.title: Log a drink in a sentence
items.text: Type “Latte 12 oz” or “Espresso double” and the caffeine is worked out from typical amounts. Your usual drinks are one tap to log again.

items.title: A timeline of your day
items.text: Watch the day's caffeine rise with each drink and fall away through the evening, with your sleep threshold and bedtime marked.

items.title: Your threshold, your bedtime
items.text: Set the level you count as clear, from 25 to 100 mg, your bedtime, and how quickly you clear caffeine.

items.title: Apple Health
items.text: Turn it on to save each drink as Dietary Caffeine. Edit or delete a drink and Apple Health follows. Caffeine Easy only writes caffeine and never reads your health data.

items.title: Widgets that keep up
items.text: Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets work the level out as the day goes on, so the time and the number stay current.

sections.label: THE SCIENCE
sections.title: 5.7 hours.
text: That's the average half-life of caffeine: every 5.7 hours, half of what's in your system is gone. Caffeine Easy adds up what's left of every drink and finds when you'll be under your sleep threshold. It's an estimate, not medical advice.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking. No account. Caffeine Easy doesn't make network requests. Your drinks stay on your device, and go to Apple Health only if you turn it on.

cta.title: Know when you'll be clear.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
